description: Get one random CELPIP practice item from CELPass in the real test format. Reading (parts 1–4): a passage or diagram with multiple-choice questions and fill-in blanks shown as ____(n). Listening (parts 1–6): the questions plus a listen_url where the learner plays the recording (no transcript). Speaking (parts 1–8): the task, any picture, and the preparation and speaking times. Writing (tasks 1–2): the email or survey task with its time limit and word count. No answers are included: mark Reading and Listening with check_celpip_answers, and compare Speaking and Writing with get_celpip_sample_answers. Each day has a new set of items (3 per part), the same for everyone; calls return a random one from today's set.

part.description: Part number (Reading 1–4, Listening 1–6, Speaking 1–8, Writing 1–2); omit for any part
